details: macOS 13.7.8, NewChirp 1.0.61, FTDI cable /dev/cu.usbserial-AE9NJ8YH, Yaesu_FT-2900R_1900R driver. Two reads 14-23 s each ended with 'Failed to read header': the radio sent no clone header. That is the usual sign it was not put into clone mode or not told to send (hold MHz(PRI) at power-on, then press LOW(ACC) after clicking Read). Setup is suspected; not a confirmed driver defect.
